label: Hilink HL23446 GPON SFP ONU
description: GPON ONU built into an SFP module (Lantiq PEB98035, OpenWRT) that plugs into the router's SFP/SFP+ cage and presents a 2.5G HSGMII host interface; GPON line rate 2.488 Gbit/s down / 1.244 Gbit/s up on SC/APC, no LAN ports and no Wi-Fi, managed over its web UI.
